Name: Storbee's Galaxy Sword and Infinity Blade Retexture
Author: Storbees
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This mod gives you a few different looks for the infinity blade and one for the galaxy sword <3 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Download this mod
2. Unzip the folder
3. Put unzipped folder in your game
4. Enjoy <3

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
This mod gives you a retexture for the galaxy sword and 3 different retexture options for the infinity blade. All retextures give the swords a handle with a heart emblem at the center. 

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[b]Mods needed[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list][b]This mod is incompatible with other weapon retextures[/b]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This video by cozygoat is literally the only reason I could make this mod. I encourage anyone who wants to make retextures to do it! It's way easier then I thought it would be[/color]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][youtube]gX0FT-aNRrY[/youtube][/color]

[left][color=#D4D4D8]
Thank you as well to the Redditors who helped me work through my rookie mistake. Without you I would've been stuck on something really stupid for a lot longer lol[/color]
[/left]
[/center]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]And as always shout out ConcernedApe and the whole modding community for making it so accessible to make your own mod[/color][/size]
